messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 44(2)

Article 44 Union safeguard procedure. 2. If the national measure is considered to be justified, all Member States shall ensure that appropriate restrictive measures, such as withdrawal, are taken in respect of the non-compliant product within the scope of this Regulation, and shall inform the Commission accordingly. If the national measure is considered to be unjustified, the Member State concerned shall withdraw that measure.

response.text:
all Member States | ensureRestrictiveMeasures | appropriate restrictive measures, such as withdrawal, are taken in respect of the non-compliant product within the scope of this Regulation | national measure is considered to be justified | "all Member States shall ensure that appropriate restrictive measures, such as withdrawal, are taken in respect of the non-compliant product within the scope of this Regulation"
all Member States | informCommission | the Commission of the restrictive measures taken | national measure is considered to be justified | "shall inform the Commission accordingly"
Member State concerned | withdrawNationalMeasure | that national measure | national measure is considered to be unjustified | "the Member State concerned shall withdraw that measure"
